text:
Our builds used to take 14 minutes on Jenkins. That's long enough to lose your train of thought, so we moved to GitHub Actions. Builds now take 6 minutes, less than half what they used to.

It also cut our costs. Our monthly CI bill went from $900 to $410.

The migration went more smoothly than we expected. It took three weeks to move 41 pipelines. We didn't just copy the old configs across. We rebuilt each workflow so it could use GitHub's native integrations and newer tooling.

This post covers why we switched, what we learned, and what you can apply to your own pipelines. It should be useful whether you're a platform engineer, a backend developer, or anyone who wants their code to ship faster.
